original_submission.content:
import sys
import os

sys.path.append('storage/telos')
from utils.log_formatter import format_and_append_log

EVAL_ID = 485
INPUT_PATH = f"storage/telos/wip/raw_log_{EVAL_ID}.txt"
OUTPUT_PATH = "storage/telos/full_transgen_logs.jsonl"

print(f"Executing log processing for Eval ID: {EVAL_ID} with verified utility.")

if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PATH):
    print(f"Error: Input file not found at {INPUT_PATH}. Aborting.")
else:
    format_and_append_log(
        eval_id=EVAL_ID,
        input_review_path=INPUT_PATH,
        output_jsonl_path=OUTPUT_PATH
    )
    # Clean up the temp file after successful processing
    os.remove(INPUT_PATH)
    print(f"Processing script finished. Removed temp file: {INPUT_PATH}")
